address: Rua de Rodrigues Sampaio, 105, Porto, 4000-124, Portugal
bio: For a meal in a traditional Portuguese restaurant with a sophisticated touch, the renowned Casa da Calçada group has opened this new project in the centre of Porto, where the culinary focus is on conventional Portuguese cooking with hints of modernity, to a stylish backdrop of warm and welcoming tones. On the menu you’ll find the traditional cod fritters, oxtail croquettes and the time-honoured “roupa velha”, albeit prepared with a refined and delicate touch, not forgetting the classic “bacalhau à brás” and the black pork cheeks with sweet potato and roasted chestnuts. Make sure you also show due deference to the superb selection of bottles on the wine list!...
